note: Every user-facing surface of ue-mcp that is not a bridge action, hand-kept. Bridge actions are inventoried separately (behavioural-coverage.json). A test claims a surface with covers("<id>") from tests/helpers/covers.ts; scripts/integration-coverage.ts credits it when the test asserts on what the real process did. A new surface goes here together with its test or a reasoned exemption.

surfaces.summary: ue-mcp help, --help and -h print the command list and exit 0 without starting a server
ue-mcp with a stray flag exits 2 with usage instead of starting a server
ue-mcp version, --version and -v print the package version
ue-mcp <command> --help prints that command's usage, exits 0 and writes nothing, for every command
a strict command refuses a mistyped flag with exit 2 before doing any work
ue-mcp init --yes on a bare project deploys the bridge, edits the .uproject, writes ue-mcp.yml, client configs, hooks and skills
ue-mcp init --json prints one machine-readable result on stdout and nothing else
ue-mcp init --yes --dry-run prints the plan and writes nothing
ue-mcp init --install binary --binaries <local> installs prebuilt bridge binaries
running ue-mcp init a second time is idempotent
ue-mcp init without --yes walks the interactive prompts on a terminal
the ue-mcp-init package bin runs init
ue-mcp update installs the newest server from npm, then redeploys and rebuilds the bridge
ue-mcp update --apply-only redeploys the bridge from this package or local binaries
the ue-mcp-update package bin runs update
ue-mcp deploy syncs the bridge plugin into a project and enables it in the .uproject
the ue-mcp-deploy package bin runs deploy
ue-mcp build runs the engine's build script for the project's editor target and reports its exit
ue-mcp doctor reports installed versions, client configs and running servers
ue-mcp doctor --fix removes client config entries that point at missing projects
ue-mcp doctor reports an npx launch npm's release-age gate would refuse, and --fix lifts the gate in that entry
a client config ue-mcp writes starts the server through npx under min-release-age on the day of a release
ue-mcp status reports a project's install, client and editor state
ue-mcp status --json prints one JSON status report
ue-mcp daemon run serves a project in the foreground and publishes a discovery file
ue-mcp daemon start spawns a detached daemon for a project and prints where it listens
ue-mcp daemon stop shuts down a project's running daemon
ue-mcp daemon status reports whether a project's daemon is running and healthy
ue-mcp daemon open prints the daemon UI address, starting the daemon if needed
ue-mcp daemon with no or an unknown subcommand prints usage and exits 2
ue-mcp extension list lists installed daemon extensions
ue-mcp extension install unpacks an extension archive into the extensions directory
ue-mcp extension remove deletes one installed extension and nothing else
ue-mcp hook post-tool-use reads a Claude Code payload on stdin and answers with a feedback reminder
ue-mcp hook with another event kind is a silent no-op
ue-mcp uninstall-hooks removes every hook init recorded for a project
ue-mcp auth signs in to GitHub with the device flow and caches the token
ue-mcp login exchanges a GitHub token for a registry publish token
ue-mcp logout forgets the cached registry token
ue-mcp feedback mode reads and sets the stored feedback mode
ue-mcp feedback list shows deferred feedback reports
ue-mcp feedback show prints one deferred report
ue-mcp feedback discard deletes one deferred report
ue-mcp feedback approve files one deferred report and removes it from the queue
ue-mcp feedback review walks the deferred queue on a terminal
ue-mcp dialog mode reads and sets how blocking editor dialogs are handled
ue-mcp context prints the project's context strategy
ue-mcp context micro|lean|full writes the strategy into ue-mcp.yml
ue-mcp resolve works a GitHub issue into a pull request through gh, git and claude
ue-mcp plugin install adds a plugin package, validates its manifest and records it in ue-mcp.yml
ue-mcp plugin uninstall removes a plugin, its native module and its skills
ue-mcp plugin list lists the project's plugins and their status
ue-mcp plugin update reinstalls plugins at their newest version
ue-mcp plugin check-skills validates a plugin's shipped skills
ue-mcp plugin create scaffolds a new plugin package
ue-mcp plugin config enables and disables a plugin's groups
ue-mcp plugin publish uploads a plugin listing to the registry
ue-mcp plugin publish --dry-run prints the listing diff without a token or a write
ue-mcp plugin record-specs records a native module's handler specs from a running bridge
ue-mcp plugin with no or an unknown subcommand prints usage and fails
the in-process server in the micro strategy advertises the tools gateway and flow, with the micro instructions
editor(checkpoint, list_checkpoints, list_changes, restore) record and restore files written through the server with no editor running
the in-process server in the lean strategy advertises the catalog tool and trimmed category tools
the in-process server in the full strategy advertises every category tool
the stdio shim in daemon mode advertises what the micro in-process server does
the stdio shim in daemon mode advertises what the lean in-process server does
the stdio shim in daemon mode advertises what the full in-process server does
context.strategy in ue-mcp.yml picks the strategy when no env var does
server.mode in ue-mcp.yml picks daemon or in-process when no env var does
a server whose daemon cannot start serves in process instead
a server started with no project serves the default bridge
a server started with several projects runs one session per project
tool calls with no editor running answer with a clear not-connected result instead of hanging
tools(list_categories) lists every category with a summary
tools(search) ranks action signatures for a query
tools(describe) pages a category's signatures and one action's schema
tools(call) dispatches a category action and validates its args
server-side actions (project get_status, get_info, list_editors, plugins list) answer with no editor
flow(list) lists built-in, plugin and ue-mcp.yml flows
flow(plan) resolves a flow's steps without running them
flow(plan) and GET /v1/flows/<name>/plan report the inputs a run may pass, derived from the step schemas and options_schema
flow(run) runs a flow defined in ue-mcp.yml and reports each step
flow(run) runs a built-in flow against an editor
flow(run, playtest) drafts a test script with the flow model, checks it with pie(script_validate), returns refusals to the model and saves it with pie(script_create)
a flow agent step with no registered provider runs on ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
a flow agent step with no model configured fails with No model is configured for flow agent steps.
the opt-in flow HTTP server lists, plans and runs flows behind its token
guards configured in ue-mcp.yml allow or refuse a real tool call
write-method detection marks mutating calls so guards and gating see them
global config, ue-mcp.yml, the env overlay and ue-mcp.local.yml merge in order
UE_MCP_ENV or env: selects ue-mcp.<env>.yml
checkpoints are off unless ue-mcp.yml sets checkpoints: on, and the daemon overrides that per session
a newer published version adds a one-time upgrade notice to the next tool result
the editor parameter routes a call to the named project's bridge and no other
an untargeted write is refused once more than one editor is registered
project(add_editor, use_editor, drop_editor, list_editors) change the session set
the daemon publishes a discovery file and refuses requests without its token or from a foreign origin
the daemon streams tool calls and editor events on /v1/events
the daemon streams PIE test script step events on /v1/events
the shim replaces a daemon that dies without the client reconnecting
a daemon with nothing attached exits after UE_MCP_DAEMON_IDLE_MS
a newer daemon takes over from an older one for the same project
concurrent starts leave exactly one daemon per project
the daemon lists, plans and runs flows over HTTP
a spawned daemon loads extensions from the extensions directory and serves their routes
a daemon extension registers the model flow agent steps run on with api.models.register
the daemon serves only signed UI bundles at /ui
the daemon installs, updates and removes plugins over /v1/plugins
the daemon reports and applies bridge updates over /v1/update
the daemon's /v1/checkpoints routes create, list, diff, restore and clear checkpoints, arm the editor's save recording and publish checkpoint events, without touching the project's .git
the daemon lists ue-mcp's packaged skills and the project's own, with owner and location, over /v1/skills and api.skills
the compiled package, laid out as npm installs it, starts from dist/index.js and serves what the source does
the ue-mcp/task export resolves and its Task base class runs a plugin task
the ue-mcp/guard export resolves and its guard base class is usable from a plugin
the ue-mcp/daemon export resolves for daemon extensions
a project plugin's inject tasks appear as actions on the target category and run
a project plugin's provides category appears as its own tool and runs
a plugin's native module handlers become bridge-backed actions
a plugin whose minServerVersion is newer than the server is skipped with a reason
a plugin action that declares a reserved routing parameter is dropped with a reason
flows a plugin ships appear in flow(list) and run
plugin skills are installed into .claude/skills and pruned when the plugin goes
the plugin catalog is fetched from the registry and cached on disk
feedback(submit) files an approved report through the signing service
feedback(submit) in defer mode queues the report on disk
a report about a plugin's action is routed to that plugin's tracker
feedback(submit) as the user posts the issue through the GitHub API
the GitHub device flow signs the user in and caches the token
